findings.evidence: NEW round-3 P0 — cross-wave cleanup contamination, almost certainly the root cause of the round-2 38-vs-13 ambiguity. CHAIN OF EVIDENCE: (1) a013-db-reconciliation.json proves 37/38 API orders had a persisted DB row with valid fiscal_sequence_no AT THE MOMENT OF EACH POST (queried by idempotency_key immediately after each request, ~1.1s pacing). (2) End-of-test prefix sweep at spec line 1093-1094 (`SELECT ... WHERE token LIKE 'AUDIT-RUSH-A-%' ORDER BY fiscal_sequence_no ASC`) reports waveARows.length=3 → observations.json db_orders_with_prefix_count=3. (3) state-14 tracker PNG shows only 8 actives (vs 41 expected). (4) state-17 KDS shows kds={card_count_total:8, card_count_matching_prefix:3}. (5) composition-snapshot.json reports tacos_order_ids=[16 entries] but tacos_order_items_total=2 (14/16 tacos orders have NO order_items rows by end-of-test, vs 100% had order_id confirmed at post time per A-013). 38 → 3 between burst-time and end-of-test = ~92% silent disappearance. ROOT CAUSE: Iter15CleanupTestOrdersCommand (app/Console/Commands/Iter15CleanupTestOrdersCommand.php) sweeps ALL `token LIKE 'AUDIT-%'` rows whose status IN [PENDING=1, ACCEPT=4, PREPARING=7, PREPARED=8] and CASCADE-deletes order_items, order_status_transitions, transactions, domain_events, order_addresses (lines 76-83). Wave B's spec calls cleanupOrphanTestOrders() at setup (test-e2e-rush-hour-50x50-2026-05-10-wave-B.spec.js line 414) which runs the SAME artisan command. The orchestrator brief explicitly states Wave B is running in parallel ('FISCAL-A2-branch gap_free=false (40 gaps, same as round 2 — Wave B writing parallel)'). So Wave B's setup-cleanup (or its post-test cleanup) runs while Wave A is still posting active orders, deleting Wave A's AUDIT-RUSH-A-* orders that are in active status. This is NOT a product silent-loss — it's a test-harness contamination that makes EVERY subsequent set-equality check unreliable. Severity P0 because: (a) it makes the audit numerically meaningless beyond the per-order DB-confirmation evidence, (b) it explains the 14/16 missing tacos_order_items (parsimonious cascade-delete rationale per Iter15CleanupTestOrdersCommand line 80), (c) it propagates downstream to A-004 (KDS arrival timeouts after seq 20), A-006 (token search 0 matches), A-009 (KDS aggregation under-sample). NOTE: I deliberately do NOT classify this as 'product silent-loss confirmed' — that would over-attribute on this evidence. The cleanup cascade is the parsimonious explanation.
findings.fix_hint: Three viable paths: (a) WAVE-SCOPED PATTERNS — Iter15CleanupTestOrdersCommand::TOKEN_PATTERNS becomes per-wave (AUDIT-RUSH-A-%, AUDIT-RUSH-B-% etc.) so Wave B setup doesn't scoop Wave A rows; OR add a `--patterns=` CLI flag and have each wave's cleanup call pass its OWN prefix only. (b) TIMESTAMP-SCOPED — add `--older-than-ts=<ts>` flag, default to test-start-ts so cleanup only sweeps rows whose created_at < test-start (true orphans from prior runs). (c) SERIALIZE WAVES — playwright config: run wave-A and wave-B sequentially not in parallel (slow but eliminates contamination entirely). Recommend (b) — cleanest fix, keeps parallel execution, surgically scopes cleanup to true orphans. Files: app/Console/Commands/Iter15CleanupTestOrdersCommand.php (add option + filter), tests/e2e/helpers/login.js cleanupOrphanTestOrders() (pass new option). Round 4 cannot reach GREEN without this fix.

findings.evidence: NEW round-3 P2 — residual A-013 case for tracking. The 1/38 ok_no_row entry in a013-db-reconciliation.json: seq=4, idem=1778456025793_19vd8ggpy_1_A, status=201 (note: 201 not 200 — the spec returns whatever upstream returns; PosOrderController returns 201 Created on success), but dbConfirmByIdempotencyKey returns 'no_row_for_idempotency_key'. The dbConfirmByIdempotencyKey helper is inspected at spec lines 128-146 and the SQL query is correct (`WHERE idempotency_key = '...' LIMIT 1`). Three possible explanations, NONE pre-decided here per orchestrator instruction: (i) write-replication race — DB committed AFTER probe ran (probe is synchronous artisan shell-out, ~150ms after the response); (ii) middleware short-circuit returning a 201 from a stale idempotency cache without persisting a new row (would be a real product issue with IdempotencyKeyMiddleware); (iii) cross-wave cleanup A-015 deleted this specific row between commit and probe (timing race). The parallel A-013 root-cause investigation should determine which. Severity P2 (down from round-2 P0 ambiguity) because the rate is 1/38 = 2.6% — well within the noise floor of a heavily-instrumented audit run; not a re-blocking finding.
findings.fix_hint: Round 4 instrumentation: add a 200ms delay before dbConfirmByIdempotencyKey to rule out (i); add a second probe 1s later if first returns no_row, log both outcomes — if second probe finds the row it's (i), if still no row it's (ii) or (iii). Distinguish (ii) vs (iii) by checking if cleanupOrphanTestOrders ran in the audit window. If A-015 fix lands first, (iii) is eliminated.
